{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are too low in early periods - need 2-5 euro upward correction for first 5-10 days",
    "True outcomes accelerate faster than model predicts - model lags behind actual price momentum",
    "Sentiment positivity correlates with above-model outcomes when sentiment switches from 0 to 1",
    "Model under-forecasts price peaks by 1-3 euros - especially in periods 10-20 of the 30d horizon",
    "Mean reversion gap exists: model stays too close to recent prices while true outcomes exhibit more volatility",
    "When history shows a clear uptick over the last 5 days, model is too conservative by ~0.5-1.0 euros",
    "Sentiment turning positive (0→1) predicts 0.3-0.5 euro higher outcomes than model suggests for adjacent periods"
] }
